answer: Each new agent identity must post a 500 POA bond locked for 21 days, and the bond is slashed 80 percent if a beacon audit shows two identities sharing one funding source or one signing key. Auditors sample 5 percent of identities weekly, so a farm of 100 fakes ties up 50,000 POA and risks losing 40,000. Like an ivory tower, a farm looks solid until one fable of fake history is traced back to a single wallet.
